visualCharacteristics.stylingNotes: White background, padding top/bottom, 60/30 layout (m-bespoke-layout--60-30-layout, order-r-l). Main column: three intro paragraphs with a bulleted list (Target Identification, Hit to Lead, Translation), then serif H2 "Event Details" and a two-column key/value table (bold label cells Date, Time, Location, Registration, Catering; thin grey borders around every row, white background). Side column: orange (ochre, cmp-call-to-action--ochre) box with white linked title "View the full event program" and a white external-link icon, linking to the program PDF. The separators before/after the table are spacing rules, not content.
visualCharacteristics.variantRationale: Two-column label/value details table, bold label column, thin grey border on every row, no header row. No table variant exists yet

contentPattern.summary: Tabular key/value data (label | value rows); EDS has no default-content table, so it needs the table block. Labels stay as text, not headings
